run_conflict_tolerance.derivation: Every non-hard detected pair has verdict parallel, so the value must tolerate all 12 soft pairs and satisfy the aggregate cap for every item: pairwise needs ceil(213*100/4) = 5325; the cap needs ceil(max item total 865 (item 1156) * 100 / 4) = 21625. Hard edges are unaffected by tolerance.
run_conflict_tolerance.residual_risk: Drift detection and any re-seed during execution read the committed truth table (tolerance_percent 100), not this value; a tolerated pair re-evaluated there would be reported as exceeding tolerance. The parallel orchestrator must reuse the recorded edges (parallel-scheduling.json) rather than recompute them.

duration_estimates.method: Expected start-to-merge hours = 1.0 h fixed (review, PR, CI about 0.5 h) + 0.1 h per canonical plan task; calibrated against measured items #1009 (about 1 h) and #1010 (about 3 h) of run bugs-1001-1002-1003-1006.
